handoffs.message: Implementation and evidence are ready for independent review. Base PR #4148 and hardening PR #4155 are merged; merge commit 4f905c5a563483ff15eee9221c47eb720b8cecce. Focused acceptance: 127/127 including real NATS child-process crash recovery; smoke/compile/schema/checksums passed. Please review fail-closed role/service-tenant authority, tenant/content-bound JetStream receipts, lifecycle identity, and checksummed evidence.

Reviewer rejection with three acceptance blockers. (1) POST /api/telemetry/ingest/batch unconditionally returns 202 at services/telemetry/main.py:864-871; existing fixture reproduced 202 with {'ingested': 0, 'rejected': 1} for an unknown binding, so HTTP success is emitted with no durable receipt. Return non-2xx when zero events are durably accepted and define/test mixed-batch semantics. (2) RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore is keyed only by runtime_id and does not reject tenant changes: tenant-beta heartbeat on tenant-001 lifecycle produced tenant_id=tenant-001 with last_event_id/last_heartbeat_event_id from tenant-beta. Isolate by (tenant_id,runtime_id) or fail closed on cross-tenant collision; add lifecycle+heartbeat and restart/list/get negative regressions. (3) telemetry lineage GET routes authenticate X-Tenant-Id but _lineage_query_response does not pass/filter tenant; tenant-beta reproduced HTTP 200 with the complete evt-lineage-001 trace. Make every lineage read tenant-aware and fail closed for unscoped legacy records, with cross-tenant negative tests. Refresh checksummed evidence after fixes.
